description.value: Noct Coffee is a Vancouver-based specialty micro roaster and third-wave café on Main Street, operating as a self-described no-tip establishment. They roast small-batch, ethically sourced single-origin and blended coffees and host regular community events including cuppings, tastings, and pop-up workshops. The shop held its soft opening in April 2026, making it a brand-new addition to Vancouver's specialty coffee scene.
